name: LeaseDealEconomicsCalculator
tagline: Net effective rent, NPV and incentives of every lease offer – compared, stress-tested and approved in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete leasing-deal app for landlords and leasing teams: landlord cash flow, NPV, discounted and simple NER, incentive % and payback of every offer; side-by-side offer comparison per deal; cash flow with sensitivity sliders; counter-offer chain; approval authority against the budget NER with a four-eyes rule; and a drag-and-drop offer pipeline. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with built-in demo data.
features: NPV and discounted / simple net effective rent per offer
Free rent, TI, landlord works, cash incentives and commission (net or gross basis)
Annual escalation and rent per area per year or per month
Side-by-side offer comparison with best value per row and cumulative cash curves
Sensitivity sliders (discount rate, rent, free months, TI) and counter-offer from a scenario
Budget NER test and approval authority with investment-committee escalation
Four-eyes approval rule, acceptance locks the deal and loses competing offers
Pipeline board with drag and drop
Bulk propose / approve / mark lost, CSV export, undo
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: LeaseDealEconomicsCalculator data-set, LeaseDealEconomicsCalculatorPortal field)
